children: Entlaq and ED Ventures have entered a partnership to support Egypt’s entrepreneurship ecosystem and bolster innovation in the education technology sector, according to an emailed press release.
This came during the fourth edition of the Egyptian Entrepreneurship Sector Annual Report Summit (SDR 2026) held in El Gouna from September 10 to 12, 2026.

The collaboration will cover the development of a specialized report assessing the current landscape of Egypt’s education technology (EdTech) sector, including its key challenges, growth opportunities, and long-term potential to support economic growth and human capital development.
It will also offer data-driven insights into the sector’s ongoing transformation, emerging trends, and future outlook, giving stakeholders a clearer understanding of its development potential.

The partnership will also focus on backing startups operating in the education sector and reinforcing their ability to develop innovative solutions and create sustainable impact. This will contribute to expanding the role of technology in advancing the education process while enabling startups to better respond to the sector’s evolving needs.

title: ZAWYA: Entlaq, ED Ventures sign partnership deal to drive edtech innovation in Egypt
